headline: Commodity Traders Swap Financial Charts For Global Map Jigsaw Puzzles Ahead Of High-Stakes Summit
body: Global markets have begun pricing in extreme volatility by replacing traditional trading algorithms with 5,000-piece regional map puzzles, hoping that completing the image of the Pacific Ocean will reveal the exact trajectory of copper futures. Brokers confirmed that current market signals are being interpreted solely through the color-coding of remaining puzzle border pieces.
caption: Forget pivot points and moving averages; the only way to predict this summit is to find the missing piece of the maritime trade route. Wall Street is currently trading in glue sticks and card tables. #Commodities #GlobalTrade #Markets (satire)
igHook: How many puzzle pieces do you think it takes to stabilize the global economy?
imagePrompt: A cluttered, high-end financial trading desk covered with scattered jigsaw puzzle pieces instead of computer monitors, with a blurred stock exchange ticker visible in the distant background.

sourceHeadline.title: What commodity markets can expect from the Trump-Xi summit
